subject: an adult man of about 40 riding a black Dutch city bicycle to the right, sitting upright: short dark green jacket, blue jeans, dark brown boots, a small brown canvas backpack, grey cycling helmet, short dark hair and a short beard; round wheels with thin even spokes and grey tyres, a chain guard, no basket

size_sentence: his helmet top is about twice as high as the dog's head and each wheel is a little taller than the dog's back. He is a full-grown adult man, not a child.
